title: Leadership team platform: how {product} works
description: {product} helps a leadership team of 4 to 15 see how it works, then improve it meeting by meeting. Every step of the loop, and what it brings.
h1: From a three-minute scan to better meetings
lead: {product} helps a leadership team of 4 to 15 people see how it really works, then improve it meeting by meeting. It starts with a free scan any leader can run without a consultant.

steps.title: Take the Leadership Team Scan
steps.text: Twelve questions in about three minutes, with no account. Your personal view appears right after the last answer.

steps.title: Invite your group
steps.text: One link for the whole group. A counter shows how many have answered, never who.

steps.title: Read the team view together
steps.text: When the scan closes, the whole group sees level and agreement per theme. It opens only with at least four answers.

steps.title: Take the Leader Profile
steps.text: A personality profile for leaders, in a quick and a full length. It is private to you until you choose to share it.

steps.title: Agree a charter
steps.text: Purpose, team tasks and working agreements, in numbered versions. The leader drafts it, and the group agrees it.

steps.title: Run the full diagnostic
steps.text: 72 questions across 21 scales and 3 outcomes, answered anonymously. Every scale shows level, agreement and one standing.

steps.title: Choose focus areas
steps.text: At most two at a time, each with actions that have an owner and a due date.

steps.title: Meet with purpose
steps.text: Agendas where every item has a desired outcome and a team task. The meeting runs live, and open actions appear on the next agenda.

steps.title: Measure again
steps.text: A short pulse every few weeks, and a new diagnostic after six months. A change shows only when it is large enough to mean something.

items.title: From results to meetings
items.text: The loop links assessment and meetings. A focus area becomes actions with owners, and every open action appears on the next agenda.

items.title: The evidence is shown
items.text: Every scale names how strong its research is, and that rating sets how firmly the advice is worded.

items.title: Anonymous by construction
items.text: An answer is never stored with a person. Results open at close, and only with at least four answers.

items.title: Honest labels
items.text: Every score says Research-based, not yet validated. Nothing claims more than is true today.

blocks.text: The person who leads a leadership team of 4 to 15: a chief executive, a managing director, or a division or department head. Each member of that team usually leads a team of their own, and can run the same scan with it.

The Leadership Team Scan, the team view and the Leader Profile are free, for one group. The charter, the Full diagnostic, focus areas, meetings and pulses are part of the Team plan. A group’s leader can try it for 14 days.
Take the scan yourself first: it takes about three minutes. If the picture is worth sharing, invite your group with one link, and read the team view together when the scan closes.

faq.a: The Leadership Team Scan, the team view and the Leader Profile are free, for one group. The charter, the Full diagnostic, focus areas, meetings and pulses are part of the Team plan. A group’s leader can try it for 14 days.

faq.q: How long does the scan take?
faq.a: About three minutes: twelve questions, one per screen, with no account.

faq.q: When does the team view open?
faq.a: When the scan closes: when every member has answered, or after seven days. It needs at least four answers. With fewer, the scan gets one seven-day extension, and then no team view.

faq.q: Can the leader see who answered?
faq.a: No. The leader sees how many have answered, never who, and never anyone's answers.
Not yet. Every scale draws on published research, and each shows its evidence rating, but the questions themselves have not been through a validation study. Every score says so.
In the EU. The database and the application run in Frankfurt.
